TacticalIdentity: Temperature spectrum specialist — the only Mancer with both a strong heating spell and a strong cooling spell in the same base kit. Wins by engineering THERMAL SHOCK: forcing a unit from SUPERCOOLED to OVERHEATED (or reverse) in a single activation for bonus burst damage and a 1-turn STUN. Thermal Gradient Zone creates a persistent hot/cold split zone that deals THERMAL SHOCK to any unit crossing the midline. Amplifies Pyromancer output via OVERHEATED vulnerability and accelerates Cryomancer freeze escalation via OVERCOOLED.

Spells.Description: A heat projectile that deals 14 damage and applies OVERHEATED to the target (fire DoT + fire damage vulnerability). Applying OVERHEATED on a SUPERCOOLED target immediately triggers THERMAL SHOCK. Leaves HEAT_RESIDUE terrain at the impact tile for 1 turn.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: Refreshes OVERHEATED duration and deals 8 bonus compression damage
Applying OVERHEATED on a SUPERCOOLED target triggers THERMAL SHOCK immediately

AppliedEffects.Description: OVERHEATED: 4 HP/turn fire DoT; fire damage received +50%; 3-turn duration; no stacking — refreshes on reapply

TerrainChanges.Description: Impact tile becomes HEAT_RESIDUE (1-turn DoT tile dealing 4 HP to units who stand on it)

Spells.Description: A cold projectile that deals 14 damage and applies OVERCOOLED to the target (cold DoT + cold damage vulnerability + move -2). Applying OVERCOOLED on an OVERHEATED target immediately triggers THERMAL SHOCK. Flash-freezes WET targets directly to FROZEN. Leaves COLD_RESIDUE terrain at the impact tile for 1 turn.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: Refreshes OVERCOOLED duration and deals 8 bonus compression damage
Applying OVERCOOLED on an OVERHEATED target triggers THERMAL SHOCK immediately
Cold Lance hitting a CHILLED target upgrades directly to OVERCOOLED (bypasses multi-cast escalation)

AppliedEffects.Description: OVERCOOLED: 3 HP/turn cold DoT; cold damage received +50%; move range -2; 3-turn duration; no stacking — refreshes on reapply

TerrainChanges.Description: Impact tile becomes COLD_RESIDUE (1-turn chill tile; 3 HP cold damage and CHILLED -1 move for 1 turn)
Cold Lance flash-freezes WET target to FROZEN

Spells.Description: Deals 10 Thermal damage then flips the target's current temperature by multiplying it by -1.5 (clamped to ±100). OVERHEATED becomes SUPERCOOLED; OVERCOOLED becomes OVERHEATED. The flip almost always triggers THERMAL SHOCK if the target was in HOT or OVERHEATED range. The highest single-cast temperature swing in the roster.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: Inversion of HOT/OVERHEATED target crosses both ±31 thresholds — triggers THERMAL SHOCK
Inversion of SUPERCOOLED/FROZEN target crosses both ±31 thresholds — triggers THERMAL SHOCK
OVERHEATED -> OVERCOOLED: 8 bonus thermal shock damage from sudden reversal
OVERCOOLED -> OVERHEATED: 8 bonus thermal shock damage from sudden reversal

AppliedEffects.Description: Current temperature × -1.5, clamped to [-100, +100]. OVERHEATED -> OVERCOOLED (with shock bonus). OVERCOOLED -> OVERHEATED (with shock bonus). CHILLED -> OVERHEATED. BURNING extinguished when inverting from heat to cold. FROZEN cancelled when inverting from cold to heat.

TerrainChanges.Description: OVERHEATED->OVERCOOLED inversion in STEAM_CLOUD collapses steam to ICE_TILE
OVERCOOLED->OVERHEATED inversion in STEAM_CLOUD collapses steam to HEAT_RESIDUE

Spells.Description: Places a persistent 6-tile zone (3-tile hot half + 3-tile cold half) for 4 turns. Hot half is BURNING terrain: units take 5 HP/turn fire DoT and receive OVERHEATED on entry (+15 temperature/turn). Cold half is PERMAFROST terrain: 3 HP/turn cold DoT and OVERCOOLED on entry (-15 temperature/turn). Any unit crossing the midline triggers THERMAL SHOCK. Thermomancer is immune to the zone's DoT but not to midline crossing shock.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: Any unit crossing from cold half to hot half (or reverse) in one movement action triggers THERMAL SHOCK at the midline tile
FLOODED tiles in hot half become STEAM_CLOUD for the zone's remaining duration (instead of standard 2-turn expiry)
Cryomancer ice spells in cold half apply OVERCOOLED in 1 application instead of 2

AppliedEffects.Description: 6-tile zone with hot and cold halves. Hot half: BURNING terrain, OVERHEATED on entry. Cold half: PERMAFROST terrain, OVERCOOLED on entry. Thermomancer immune to own zone DoT. Zone expires after 4 turns leaving HEAT_RESIDUE (hot) and COLD_RESIDUE (cold) for 1 additional turn.

TerrainChanges.Description: Hot half becomes BURNING terrain for zone duration
Cold half becomes PERMAFROST terrain for zone duration

Spells.Description: The Thermomancer's ultimate — a massive simultaneous release of both thermal extremes in a 3-tile AoE. Deals 30 Thermal damage to all targets in range. All targets immediately receive both OVERHEATED and OVERCOOLED simultaneously, triggering THERMAL SHOCK on every unit hit. Applies a +45 temperature swing followed by a -45 temperature swing in the same instant, crossing both ±31 thresholds. All affected units are STUNNED for 1 turn. Thermomancer cannot move this turn.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: All targets hit by Thermoclasm undergo forced THERMAL SHOCK regardless of prior temperature state
Targets already at a temperature extreme take 15 additional bonus thermal detonation damage

AppliedEffects.Description: Forces THERMAL SHOCK on all targets in AoE. 1-turn STUN applied to all affected units. Both OVERHEATED and OVERCOOLED applied simultaneously then consumed by the shock. Hot half terrain under the AoE becomes BURNING; cold half becomes ICE_TILE based on nearest zone orientation.

TerrainChanges.Description: AoE center becomes superheated HEAT_RESIDUE; outer ring becomes COLD_RESIDUE — a thermal shockwave pattern
